workerResult.summary: Ice Melt: sci-fi-terminal glacier melt visualizer. Scroll = time travel 1900→2100. Canvas melt sim (calving, drips, ripples, snow, embers) driven by temp-anomaly anchor model; year scrubber fully synced to scroll both ways; sea-level meter (0→1.0m) on left. Boot sequence, scanlines, telemetry panel, timeline rail. Works at 375px.
